description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is a New Style Grill Retro-Fit kit
Includes everything you need to change your “old style” Grill to a “new style” Grill
The Front Grill is made from High Impact Plastic and is pre-finished in a Gray Metallic.
The Front Support Brackets are pre-finished in Satin Black
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Grill (damaged as noted below)
Qty 1 – Grill Mesh
Qty 1 – Suzuki “S” Emblem
Qty 2 – Support Brackets
Qty 4 – Plastic Screw Nuts
Qty 6 – Grill Attachment Screws
Qty 4 – Support Bracket Attachment Screws
What Vehicles Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1991
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984
NOTE: This grill has a damaged peg that holds into place on the outer fender. This item is non-returnable.
